name: sharex shortcuts
description: Compact ShareX shortcut bar with region capture, scrolling capture, QR region scan, screenshots folder, and quick ShareX restore.
author: FuncOverlay

settingsSchema.label: ShareX Executable Path
settingsSchema.description: Path to ShareX.exe (auto-detected if left at default or installed elsewhere).

settingsSchema.label: Screenshots Folder Override
settingsSchema.description: Optional custom screenshots directory. Leave blank to detect ShareX's configured Screenshots folder.

settingsSchema.label: QR Scan CLI Argument
settingsSchema.description: ShareX CLI command used for Scan QR Code (default: -QRCodeScanRegion; alternative: -QRCodeDecodeFromScreen or -QRCode).
